title.en: Led Zeppelin at Madison Square Garden 1973

summary.en: Hard rock at sports-arena scale. Peak touring Zeppelin, later tied to The Song Remains the Same.
summary.zh: Hard rock 做到体育场馆规模。巡演巅峰期 Zeppelin，后来绑上 The Song Remains the Same。

whyEpic.en: MSG shows from this tour freeze the Zeppelin template: stop-start dynamics, Bonham's drums, Plant's high vocals in a concrete room. The Song Remains the Same turns the tour into lasting footage. Agree or not with the myth-making—the scale is the point.
whyEpic.zh: 这轮巡演的花园广场场次冻住了 Zeppelin 模板：骤停骤起、Bonham 的鼓、Plant 在水泥空间里的高音。《The Song Remains the Same》把巡演做成长期影像。认不认神话包装另说——规模本身是重点。
